name: Study
description: A freezing study filled floor-to-ceiling with books. Your breath fogs in the cold air. A large oak desk dominates the center, covered in papers and an old typewriter. A dim lamp offers weak light. One of the desk drawers is locked. A fierce draft seeps through a boarded-up window.

items.name: desk
items.description: A heavy oak desk with a locked drawer on the right side. The lock is small and ornate â€” a brass key might fit it.

items.name: letter
items.description: A yellowed, handwritten letter, the ink faded with age.

items.name: typewriter
items.description: An old Remington typewriter. A half-finished page is still rolled in: 'The old house keeps its secrets well. Only those who look closely will find what lies beneath...'

items.name: lamp
items.description: A brass desk lamp with a green glass shade. It casts a warm pool of light across the desk.

items.name: Letter to the King
items.description: A sealed letter addressed to King Nicolas . It appears to detail a nefarious plot involving the princesses' sixteenth birthday.

exits.description: A heavy oak door leading to the study.
